rules.rationale: This is the guarded base equation of the factorAcc mathematical summary: when the remaining value is below the candidate divisor, it defines the summary result to be the accumulated sequence.
This is the divisible-case recurrence defining factorAcc by appending the current divisor, replacing the remaining value by the supplied-semantics quotient, and recurring at the same divisor.
This is the non-divisible-case recurrence defining factorAcc by advancing the candidate divisor while preserving the accumulator and remaining value.
